name: Medicine shortages
value: UK SSPs in force; SA public-sector shortages
summary: UK Serious Shortage Protocols run into January; South Africa reports critical public-sector shortages
state: NHSBSA's list checked on 15 Nov shows active Serious Shortage Protocols for lansoprazole orodispersible tablets to 15 Jan 2027, and for Estradot patches and Creon 25000 capsules to 8 Jan 2027, with nothing issued or amended since 2 Oct (NHSBSA). In South Africa, the health department's October hotlist names 165 products in critical shortage, with public patients given reduced supplies or sent to private pharmacies (TimesLIVE, 5 Nov). No widespread rationing across major health systems was found, so this stays at Watch.
for_you: Patients on affected medicines may be given an alternative under a Serious Shortage Protocol. In the UK, the NHS advises speaking to a pharmacist or GP before stopping or changing any medicine.
rubric_hit: Watch: UK Serious Shortage Protocols in force for widely used medicines (lansoprazole, Estradot, Creon)
basis_detail: FDA, EMA and NHSBSA shortage lists
basis_by: FDA, EMA and NHSBSA shortage lists

sources.title: TimesLIVE — Dire short supply: state patients must buy medicine privately

why: Shipping disruption, factory failures and export curbs can leave essential medicines short, as with US IV fluids after Hurricane Helene in 2024.
drivers: Manufacturing concentrated in India and China, shipping, raw materials, demand spikes, regulation.

rubric.alert: Shortages forcing widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems.
rubric.watch: A shortage of an essential medicine or supply across several countries, or a UK Serious Shortage Protocol for a widely used medicine.
rubric.normal: No widespread shortages of essential medicines in major health systems.
